title: Joy to the Beach! - Vacation Rental in Gulf Place 30A,FL | 30a Escapes
description_expanded: 30A Escapes presents… "Joy to the Beach!" This delightful 3-story home in Gulf Place radiates charm in a serene, laid-back community. With an open-concept living area, a private courtyard with a grill, and accommodations for up to 8 guests, it’s your perfect beach retreat. Just a 2-minute stroll to Ed Walline Beach Access and steps from shopping and dining, every moment is pure bliss. Plus, with 4 beach bikes, exploring the beauty of 30A has never been more joyful!*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Steps to the Beach: Just steps to the Ed Walline Beach Access, offering public restrooms, outdoor showers, and a boardwalk for easy entry to the pristine 30A sandsPrime Location: A short walk to Gulf Place's popular restaurants, shops, and cafes, including Shunk Gulley and The Perfect PigSpacious Comfort: Two king beds, 2 twin beds, and bunk beds make this home perfect for families or groupsEnjoy serene Gulf breezes and beautiful views from the 2nd and 3rd-floor balconies, ideal for morning coffee or evening cocktailsOutdoor Entertaining: A private courtyard with a grill offers the perfect setting for family cookouts and relaxing eveningsNearby Convenience: Easy access to Publix, Walmart, and Shunk Gulley Liquors for all your essentialsPet Friendly: Bring your furry friend along to enjoy coastal adventures, scenic trails and salty breezes by your side. Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "The house was spotless, beautifully appointed, and perfectly located just steps from the beach and restaurants. Loved the Gulf-view balconies and family-friendly amenities!" – Dianna B.⭐ "Perfect location near the beach, shopping, and dining. The home was clean, spacious, and comfortable for two families. We loved the outdoor grill!" – Dennis M.⭐ "We had a wonderful stay! The home was very clean and beautifully decorated. The location near Ed Walline Beach Access with restrooms and showers was ideal for our family!" – Melissa T.*** LIVING AREA ***First Floor Living Area: Open-concept space combining the kitchen, dining, and living areas. Features comfortable seating, a Smart TV, and direct access to the back porch and courtyard*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Fully Equipped Kitchen: Modern appliances, ample counter space, and a bar top with seating for 4Culinary Ready: Everything necessary to cook and serve most mealsDining Area: Adjacent to the kitchen, the dining table seats 8, perfect for family meals*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Back Porch: Accessed from the living area, includes a grill and paved patioFenced Backyard: Features seating for 8, ideal for outdoor dining and relaxationSecond and Third Floor Balconies: Each with two Adirondack chairs, offering serene spots to enjoy the beach breeze*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st Floor:Half Bathroom: Conveniently located near the living area2nd Floor:King Guest Suite: King-size bed with access to the private balcony and shared hallway bathroomTwin Guest Suite: Two Twin-size beds with access to the shared hallway bathroomGuest Bathroom: Features a single sink and a shower/tub combo with a sliding glass doorWorkstation: Desk located on the second-floor landing for remote work needs3rd Floor:Primary Suite: King-size bed with en suite bathroom, including double vanities and a glass-enclosed shower. Private access to the third-floor balconyAdditional Sleeping Area: Set of twin bunk beds on the third-floor landing, suitable for extra guests*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Ed Walline Beach Access: A 2-minute walk (400 yards), featuring public restrooms, outdoor showers, and a boardwalk for easy access to the pristine beachGulf Place Community: A lively beach neighborhood offering shopping, dining, art galleries, and local boutiques. Enjoy vibrant nightlife, live music, and convenient access to stand-up paddleboard rentalsNearby Blue Mountain Beach Community: A laid-back, low-key area neighboring Dune Allen and Grayton Beach. Explore the famous Blue Mountain Creamery, open-air dining options, and the scenic Timpoochee Trail Bike Path*** PET FRIENDLY ***Non shedding, housebroken dogs onlyPets are not allowed on furniture or bedsMust be kept in a crate when guests are not with their dogWith non-refundable pet fee $250 + tax*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance: Not included in quotes but available for purchase during the reservation process or obtained independentlyPayment Methods: We DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentBeach Bikes: Waiver required to get access to the 4 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesConstruction Notice: There is currently active construction behind the property*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 96438STRO #: STR23-002418

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Essentials: Olive Oil and Salt & Pepper Starter Supplies
